# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **m156 platform refresh**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates the bundled renderer and modernizes support across Windows, Apple, Uno, and Android. It also improves image and text-processing efficiency, fixes native stream lifetime handling, and hardens managed string conversion.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m156** — Refreshes the bundled renderer with upstream Chrome m156 fixes. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native string data is read safely** — FromCString now avoids reading past its native buffer and writes directly into SKData. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Synchronizes texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother Android presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Image and text processing avoid unnecessary work** — Managed image pixel copies and HarfBuzz feature-string decoding now reduce intermediate native allocations. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention so native stream resources can be released when no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Bundled HarfBuzz symbols load reliably on Linux** — Binds bundled HarfBuzz functions locally so Linux applications consistently use the packaged native implementation. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))

## Platform

- **Uno Platform 7 is supported** — Builds SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI against Uno Platform 7 and includes WebGPU support directly in the WebAssembly native library. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Windows native builds are modernized** — Aligns Windows library dependencies with MAUI 9 and 10, and updates the Windows toolchain and ANGLE dependency. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
- **Apple deployment targets are raised** — Updates the minimum supported Apple platform versions for current platform tooling. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
